description.en: Over fifty customizable dot-matrix loaders and pixel indicators for shadcn/ui.
description.zh: 超过 50 款专为 shadcn/ui 打造的高可定制点阵式像素 Loading 加载动画库。

content.en: Dot Matrix brings industrial, retro LED matrix displays to modern React applications. Created by Shawn, it provides over 50 unique dot-matrix loading indicators, wave patterns, digital digit counters, and pixel pulse animations fully compatible with the shadcn component ecosystem.
content.zh: Dot Matrix 将工业仪器与老式 LED 点阵显示屏的机械美学带入现代 React 界面。由 Shawn 精心构建，全库包含超 50 款独具特色的点阵式 Loading 动画、正弦波浪律动、数字阵列刷新与像素脉冲反馈，深度适配 shadcn 架构，极客风格出众。
